narrative:
Morgan County has 8,750 registered voters, with 15.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 41.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 38.7%, a modest Republican lean of 3.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.8% of registrants.
